title: Cart doesn't match
story: Asha asks for groceries for the week, but the cart ShopBot builds is six bottles of premium whisky. The shop type and amount look fine, yet the cart check says mismatch, so the Guard asks Asha. Her consent screen says plainly that the cart doesn't match what she asked for, and she declines.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: I've got a cart at FreshMart for INR 4,800. Getting it checked.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: Asking AgentPay Guard before I pay.

chat.speaker: asha
chat.text: Whisky? That's not what I asked for. Declining.

what_to_notice: Grocery shop, under every limit, a merchant Asha knows: only the cart check caught this. Open the consent screen in the phone frame: the reason is in plain words, so Asha knows why she is being asked.
